description: This file defines functions to retrieve registry data for setup and status of channel plugins (Slack, Mattermost, Line) in a testing context, including test cases and snapshot assertions.

methods.name: getSetupContractRegistry
methods.description: Returns an array of setup contract entries with test cases for different channel plugins.

methods.name: getStatusContractRegistry
methods.description: Returns an array of status contract entries with test cases and snapshot assertions for different channel plugins.
